environment: **Organization**: None — personal and client work by Pascal Allen (Crimson Drive Design LLC)
**Source control**: github.com/pascalallen/* repos and their origin remotes are trusted; git and gh operations against them are routine

**Repository visibility**: check per repo with `gh repo view --json visibility`; a push to a PUBLIC repo is publishing — only that repo's own work, never secrets, credentials, customer data, phone numbers, or names of private repos
**Secrets management**: none central; local .env and ./secrets/ files (gitignored); GitHub tokens come from the gh keychain via the shell profile, never written to files
**Default / protected branches**: main; agents never merge — Pascal reviews and merges every PR
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything tagged `prod` or `production`
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development — Go (DDD + hexagonal + CQRS), PHP/Symfony, React; Docker-based dev via bin/up, bin/down, bin/exec
